reason: I already trade for free on Robinhood and Public, and I'm not adding another monthly bill on top of the subscriptions I have just to invest under $20k. Plus I like making my own trades, so I don't need a pet doing it for me.
objection: Paying a monthly fee on a small account eats my returns, and the price isn't even set yet, so I'd be signing up for a waitlist to pay for something I can already do for free.
would_change_my_mind: If the real-money plan were free or tied to my account size, like a tiny percentage with no flat monthly fee, I'd at least try it.
